FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Creative Canvas Designs specializes in providing high-quality graphic design and commercial art services tailored to meet the unique needs of small businesses and non-profits. Our operations focus on delivering digital design solutions, including branding, logo design, marketing materials, and web graphics. We operate exclusively in a digital environment, utilizing licensed software and secured cloud-based storage for all client projects, ensuring that all assets are protected and compliant with industry standards. Our team consists of skilled designers who collaborate closely with clients to ensure each project meets expectations and is delivered on time.

By prioritizing a seamless digital workflow, we eliminate the risks associated with physical production or installation. We do not engage in large-scale production or placement, further minimizing liability exposure. All subcontractors are carefully vetted and required to provide proof of insurance, and we maintain clearly documented contracts with all clients. This allows us to focus on our core competencies in graphic design while maintaining a streamlined and efficient operation.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Creative Canvas Designs also owns "Canvas Creative Co." which focuses on custom illustration services, operating exclusively from a home office and following all industry standards.
